dressCode.heading: Dress Code
dressCode.intro: Devotees are requested to wear traditional Indian attire when visiting the temple. Modest clothing that respects the sanctity of the temple is mandatory.

rules.heading: Rules & Regulations
rules.photography: Photography and videography inside the sanctum are strictly prohibited.
rules.phones: Please switch off or keep mobile phones in silent mode.
rules.silence: Devotees are requested to maintain silence and discipline inside the temple premises.
rules.food: Outside food and beverages are not allowed inside the temple.

facilities.heading: Facilities
facilities.text: The temple provides facilities such as safe drinking water, clean restrooms, and a dedicated area for pilgrims to rest. Special assistance is available for elderly and physically challenged devotees.

media.title: Media & Updates
media.intro: Latest announcements, events, and gallery updates will appear here when available.

donations.title: Donations — Coming Soon
donations.intro: We are preparing a transparent and devotional donations experience. Your contributions will be handled with care and clear accounting.
donations.onlineComingSoonText: Donation forms and payment options will be enabled soon by the temple administration.

archive.footnote2: "ఈ పేజీలో ఉన్న సమాచారం చారిత్రక రికార్డుల ఆధారంగా పొందుపరచబడింది. ఇది సమాచార ప్రయోజనాల కొరకు మాత్రమే."
